title: Jon Vinyl Drops Stunning New Single "Pressure (Remix)"
htmlContent:
A rhythm full of climates and an exceptional voice is what we will find in "Pressure (Remix)," a single recently released by Jon Vinyl.

A song full of beautiful tempos and with very well-crafted arrangements, this track has excellent musical constructions rarely heard in recent releases, presenting an exquisite work both in the instrumental part and in the delivery of vocals with a lot of feeling and an enviable production in which everything is heard very clearly at all times.

Stream "Pressure (Remix)" on Spotify
